metadata.title: Survey Data Protection

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for securing survey responses and associated metadata throughout retention, access, use, and disposal.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Survey data stores, response repositories, analytics staging areas, and archival systems.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Constraint pattern governing protection, access, retention, and disposal of survey response data after collection.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Survey data protection applies to all data produced by surveys governed under Survey Core.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.value: MP, CP, IA, AC, AU, SC
props.remarks: Survey data protection aligns with NIST SP 800-53 controls governing data handling, access, encryption, and auditability.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Survey data protection aligns with Privacy Framework principles for minimization, retention limitation, and secure disposal.

metadata.remarks: Survey Data Protection defines enforceable controls over survey responses and related metadata after collection. This pattern ensures that survey data is protected against unauthorized access, re-identification, misuse, over-retention, and improper secondary use, in accordance with the promises made to respondents.

components.title: Survey Data Access Control
components.description: Restricts access to survey responses and metadata to authorized roles and approved use cases.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of valid credentials to access survey data beyond authorized scope.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Role-based and purpose-restricted access control limits survey data exposure.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Access to survey data is explicitly authorized and reviewed.
Mechanisms enforce approved access to survey data.

components.title: Survey Data Confidentiality
components.description: Protects survey data from unauthorized disclosure during storage, processing, and transfer.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Eavesdropping or exposure of survey data in transit or at rest.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Encryption and secure transmission mechanisms protect survey data confidentiality.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cryptographic mechanisms protect survey data confidentiality.
Transmission confidentiality and integrity are enforced.

components.title: Survey Data Retention and Disposal
components.description: Ensures survey data is retained only as long as necessary and securely disposed of thereafter.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Unauthorized persistence or reuse of survey data beyond its approved lifecycle.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle management and secure disposal reduce residual data exposure.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Survey data is securely deleted or destroyed in accordance with retention requirements.
Backup and recovery processes do not extend survey data retention beyond approved periods.

components.title: Secondary Use and Re-identification Prevention
components.description: Prevents survey data from being reused, linked, or re-identified beyond the original consent and purpose.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Derivation or inference of personal attributes from survey data through unauthorized correlation.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Data minimization and separation controls reduce re-identification risk.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Data use is limited to the stated purpose communicated to respondents.
Mechanisms prevent unauthorized linkage between survey data and identities.
